pattern: に基づいて（にもとづいて）
purpose: Base an action or judgment on an authoritative foundation.
keywords: We revised the plan on the basis of the survey results.
We will charge the fee in accordance with the contract.
We requested an explanation based on facts.
restrictions: Common foundations include facts, rules, data, and plans.
mistake: Use をもとに for material creatively adapted rather than a governing basis.
